status: Protocol design and offline state model only; no new admission enforcement or SQL proposal installed
scope: Merge work packages 1 and 2; preserve existing six controls, immutable source claims and non-expiring holds.

finding.current_issue: Both producers insert through the caller client after scanning. Neither reserves future summary capacity. Generic admission has no student/source argument; the atomic worker claim currently creates a fresh summary operation.
finding.unsafe_shortcut: Do not cap only begin_document_operation, insert a second counted summary at claim, or let queue insertion alone release the producer obligation.

accounting.unit: One unfinished work obligation, independent of status labels and elapsed time.
accounting.numeric_policy: Not selected or authorized by this design. Existing upload limits remain five unresolved attempts per actor and ten per student; these are a separate count, not a new global/provider budget.

admit.summary: No independent fresh admission. Transfer the already-counted exact queue obligation.

accounting.transfer: One immutable obligation ID survives promised -> queued -> claimed -> completed. Queuing and claiming neither add nor remove a unit.
accounting.release: Only a validated guarded domain completion releases its own unit. A source-bound confirmed quarantine may settle the unused promised-summary unit; unknown scan/queue/finish outcomes retain it. No ordinary held->completed, expiry, deletion or reset.
accounting.held: A producer hold does not block a separately committed queued obligation from draining. Its own unresolved unit stays counted.
accounting.limits: All three dimensions checked and reserved in one READ COMMITTED transaction under one common capacity lock. Pre-reserve both producer units before Storage/provider work. At cap, permit exact counted transfers and guarded completion; reject new reservations.

required_interfaces.change: Extend the existing attempt-bound register transaction to reserve producer and promised-summary obligations together before returning an upload reservation. Exact retry adds neither unit nor new capability.
Replace generic actor/kind-only admission with current-viewer/student/document/revision/object/hash-bound admission; reserve both obligations before download/scanner IO.
Bind the one work obligation to the exact viewer/student/source operation before save. An actor-only lease cannot establish student quota accounting.

Replace both direct document-summary inserts with one source-bound atomic queue-transfer RPC. Verify current caller authority, exact producer operation/source and clean scan; create one queued job plus immutable obligation binding in the same transaction. No replay after an uncertain reply.

Extend the reviewed claim_admitted_document_summary transaction to transfer the exact queued obligation to its existing atomic operation. Never check for an additional free slot at claim; reject missing, mismatched or previously transferred bindings. Preserve strict one-use claim receipts.

Retain existing source/actor/domain completion guards and bind capacity settlement to their exact successful outcome in the same transaction. needs_review never frees capacity through ordinary finish.

Fence document-summary inserts and generic fresh summary admissions that lack an exact producer/capacity binding, including service paths. Raw privileged bypasses remain an operational boundary requiring separate drain proof.

transactions.lock_order: Control fence -> common capacity serialization -> operation/source/domain locks in one reviewed order. Audit all existing finish/attempt/job triggers before selecting the final SQL lock order; no nested independent producer/worker ordering.
transactions.snapshot: READ COMMITTED only; after a waited lock, counts and source authority must use a fresh command snapshot.
transactions.rollback: Producer reservation, queue transfer and worker claim each commit all bindings/state changes together or none.
transactions.pause: New reservations and queued worker starts remain blocked while paused under current policy. Already-active operations can settle guarded outcomes. At-cap draining means transfers when unpaused, not bypassing pause. Resume and trusted reconciliation rules require separate review.
transactions.unknown_reply: Keep committed obligations counted; do not reconstruct a capability, requeue, repeat provider IO or silently release capacity.
transactions.installation: Paused/drained preflight with exact routine hashes, owners, fixed paths, RLS and private table/column grants. Existing queues and legacy unbound work require explicit review; no automatic adoption or backfill.

acceptance_required: Two-unit producer reservation refuses atomically when only one unit is free.
Actor, student and global ceilings independently reject new obligations.
Concurrent final-slot producer admissions serialize; rollback leaves all slots free.
Exact reserved upload retry does not create capacity or new capabilities.
Queue transfer at capacity preserves total and actor/student counts.
Worker claim at capacity preserves counts and can drain the accepted queue.
Producer completion cannot free a still-queued summary unit.
Producer needs_review retains its own unit while its committed summary can drain.
Malformed or foreign actor/student/source/operation/receipt transfer refuses without mutation.
Duplicate queue transfer and duplicate worker claim refuse; no second job or obligation.
Unknown queue/claim/finish replies retain exact obligations and never replay external IO.
Confirmed quarantine settles only its exact producer/promise; scanner uncertainty releases nothing.
Held work does not expire, reopen or clear via ordinary finish, job status edits or deletion.
Current access loss blocks new actions but never removes existing counted obligations.
Direct authenticated/service document-summary inserts and generic unbound starts refuse.
Pause-vs-admit/queue/claim races preserve fence semantics; active guarded completion still works.
Separate admission/upload owners and fixed-path/private-grant preflight remain enforced.
Four-kind/all-applicable-role adapters preserve caller RLS and keep private receipts out of browser/provider/output/logging.
Independent actual PostgreSQL race tests, full-schema replay and intercepted worker/handler tests precede any hosted request.
proof_boundary: The offline model checks accounting of the proposed protocol, not SQL enforcement, real transaction races, access policy, provider cessation or hosted behavior.
next: Implement the private obligation ledger and exact producer/queue/worker transfer SQL together; then wire all affected adapters. Do not ship a partial generic cap.
